goal: Record owner approval of the revised Search 2.0 desktop/mobile search-results-tour-selection direction so implementation can proceed under the existing redesign contract.
invariants: this task records a design decision only and cannot implement product code
approval applies to the documented Search 2.0 desktop/mobile direction, not unrelated screens
implementation remains bound by the downstream task owns_paths and protected contracts
homepage and country/resort pages keep a compact search entry while /poisk-turov/ uses the expanded search workspace
expanded search contains hotel rating instead of tour operator and exposes instant confirmation as a first-class checkbox
hotel stars, hotel rating and meal plan belong to the primary search and must not be needlessly duplicated as full sidebar filter sections

results sidebar is for deeper choice criteria such as actual tour price, beach/location, flight, baggage, airline/airport, hotel facilities, family/adults-only signals, availability and tour operator when supported by reliable data
hotel result cards remain hotel-level: show price-from, number of tours and instant-confirmation availability, with Show tours as the primary CTA

Buy now must never appear on a hotel-level price-from card; it is allowed only for a concrete tour after dates, room, meal, flight/operator and current price are known and instant confirmation has been revalidated
a concrete instant-confirmation tour may expose Buy now as primary CTA while preserving Leave a request as the secondary fallback
mobile keeps the same search and result semantics while full filters open in a dedicated compact panel/drawer

design_approval.evidence: Owner approved the revised Search 2.0 direction in chat on 2026-09-01 after reviewing the new desktop/mobile mockup and the instant-confirmation purchase flow.

done_when: REDESIGN_SEARCH_RESULTS may proceed toward the revised target while preserving Tourvisor, local-filter, progressive-result, stale-state, pricing and lead contracts
approval_evidence: Owner approved the revised Search 2.0 search/results/concrete-tour UX target and instructed implementation to continue on 2026-09-01.
